blocks.text: A familiar world. Three connected communities. And a teaser that leaves one question hanging: what is coming to CABAL?

Combo Interactive, the publisher behind CABAL: Infinite Combo and CABAL: Ultimate Combo, is stirring curiosity across Southeast Asia. With the Philippines, Thailand, and Indonesia all part of the picture, the first clues point toward something shared but offer no clear answer about what it could be.
For Cabalistas, that leaves plenty of room for speculation.
What connects the three countries? What should players be looking for in the teaser? And could the smallest detail hold the biggest clue?
Every Detail Raises a Question
The teaser offers a glimpse, but keeps the wider story hidden.
A closer look might spark a new theory. A second viewing might change it entirely. Until more is revealed, players are left to piece together what they have seen and decide what it could mean.
Is there a clue others have overlooked? Do guildmates share the same prediction or see something completely different?
For now, the questions are part of the intrigue.
Three Communities, a Shared Curiosity
Across the Philippines, Thailand, and Indonesia, Cabalistas have their own stories, rivalries, and reasons for playing. This mystery gives them something new to share.

For longtime players, it is another reason to reconnect with guildmates and revisit what keeps them invested in the world of CABAL. For those watching from the sidelines, it is an invitation to take a closer look.
The full picture remains hidden, but the conversation can begin.
What Is Your Theory?
Watch carefully. Compare notes. Share your predictions.
Further clues and details will be shared through official announcements. Until then, one question remains:
What is CABAL preparing, and how much has the teaser already told us?
Follow the official CABAL Facebook group for upcoming clues and announcements.
ADVT.
